stanzas: When Israel was in Egypt's land
Oppress'd so hard they could not stand
The Lord, by Moses, to Pharaoh said: Oh! let my people go
If not, I'll smite your first-born dead—Oh! let my people go
orig.credit: African American spiritual: the opening verse and refrain as published by the Jubilee Singers (1872), then a verse of the 1862 sheet music "Oh! Let My People Go"; as quoted in Wikipedia's article
